summary: Read-only inventory of the live USB stack of the running Android (device tree, sysfs, procfs through adb shell su -c, 51 commands, capture-004 2026-11-11T17:25+05:00) compared with the NAT-040 vendor-source plan: 39 rows, 20 match, 4 consistent, 13 new, 2 unresolved, 0 mismatches. Confirmed: DWC3 0x17900000/0x10000 SPI 403; USBCON/eUSB2 control/eUSB2 PHY/USBDP/TCA at 0x178a0000..0x178e0000; SYSREG_HSI0 0x17820000; PMU 0x12860000, pd_hsi0 0x12862000, isolation +0x61c/+0x620; CMU_HSI0 0x17800000, CMU_TOP 0x22b20000; need_smc 0x17810204; repeaters 0x3e/0x4f on hsi2c 0x110b0000; four USB rails enabled in Android. Not read: clock/gate values and rates, pd_hsi0 state, controller IP id, repeater presence (debugfs not mounted, no register reads, no I2C transactions).
evidence_category: android-userland: read-only measurement of the running Android on this S24; not loader-entry state and not native-device evidence

acceptance.1_capture: met with substitutions: dmesg lines (the ring buffer starts at uptime 25774 s and holds no probe lines), /proc/iomem for 0x17820000-0x1790ffff, UDC state and speeds, DT nodes with all properties of the controller, glue, PHY, hsi2c and repeaters, regulator state by sysfs, runtime-PM state, I2C binding. NOT obtained: clk_summary lines and the controller regdump (debugfs is registered but not mounted; mounting was not done: state change, clk_summary may read CMU registers). Tracked by NAT-051. No write to any node, no settings change; the deny-list guard and tests enforce that.
acceptance.2_comparison: met for every value the capture can supply: 39 rows with expected/observed/source, 0 mismatches; controller base 0x17900000 and SYSREG_HSI0 0x17820000 confirmed. Controller version, clock rates and PHY revision registers are listed as not established.

established: Controller DWC3 at 0x17900000, window 0x10000, SPI 403 (GIC hwirq 435 live in /proc/interrupts); the kernel claims 0x1790c100-0x1790ffff.

PHY node maps 0x178a0000/0x178b0000/0x178c0000/0x178d0000/0x178e0000 (0x200,0x200,0x200,0x800,0x800), all claimed by 178a0000.phy; SYSREG_HSI0 0x17820000 (0x10000); PMU 0x12860000 (0x10000), pd_hsi0 0x12862000 (0x20), PMU USB isolation offset 0x61c and DP 0x620; CMU_HSI0 0x17800000 (pd_hsi0 cmu_id); CMU_TOP clock-controller 0x22b20000 (0x8000, compatible samsung,s5e9945-clock) containing the three L2 read addresses; need_smc 0x17810204.
Repeater nodes TUSB2E11 0x3e and PTN3222 0x4f are children of hsi2c 0x110b0000 (Linux bus 9), status okay, both drivers bound; maximum-speed super-speed.

vdd075_usb 0.75 V, vdd12_usb 1.2 V, vdd18_usb 1.8 V, vdd33_usb 3.1 V are enabled with one user each in Android and sit on s2mps28-5, s2mps28-4, s2mps27, s2mps27 (the plan's s5_l2, s4_l4, l7, l11 naming).
No iommus, dma-coherent or dma-ranges property on the glue, the controller or the PHY; no sysmmu in 0x178x-0x179x.
Android state at capture: role b_peripheral, UDC configured at high-speed (maximum super-speed), Type-C port0 with a partner, 17900000.usb and 17900000.dwc3 runtime-PM active.
PHY tune tables hs_tune_phy and ss_tune are status disabled with 0xff sentinels; DT repeater tuning pairs recorded.
not_established: Loader-entry state of rails, pd_hsi0, clocks and repeater on the RECOVERY path (that is NAT-043/NAT-046 on the native path).

Any register value: CMU_TOP/CMU_HSI0 mux-gate-divider, SYSREG_HSI0, USB and PHY registers, GSNPSID/IP id (no register reads were authorized from Android); clock rates; pd_hsi0 on/off read from genpd (inferred on from active consumers).
Which repeater is fitted: both vendor probes make no I2C transaction, so a bound driver does not show a chip; no I2C transaction was issued.
The S2MPU in front of HSI0 DMA, the 19.2 MHz reference rate, the bank behind gpio phandle 0x65 and its level.
findings: Writing the tests exposed two defects in the capture's own guard, fixed after the evidence run with the command set unchanged (manifest commands_sha256 is tested against the script): assert_read_only() bound COMMANDS as a default argument so it could check a different list than main() ran, and the deny-list pattern \bpython\b did not match python3.

The first version of comparison row C02 reported a mismatch because the expected string was formatted differently from the observed one (a comparison bug, the device-tree value was 403); the row now compares structured values and the SPI number is read from the NAT-040 README. The first C12 expectation was the measured set itself; it now derives the PMIC instance from the plan's own rail names.

Debugfs is compiled in but not mounted on this Android; clk_summary, regulator_summary, pm_genpd_summary and the dwc3 regdump are therefore not available without a state change. NAT-051 records that as a separately scoped, reverted-mount follow-up.
